title: A slope points toward a change
summary: A slope describes how quickly a value changes nearby. For the loss (weight - 3) squared, its slope is twice (weight - 3).
introduction: A slope describes how quickly a value changes nearby. For the loss (weight - 3) squared, its slope is twice (weight - 3). We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
